Modify src/static/app.js (ES5: var, function expressions).
1) DELETE the vars loadNemotronBtn, unloadNemotronBtn, loadDeepseekBtn, unloadDeepseekBtn and their four addEventListener blocks near the bottom.
2) ADD vars: ejectModelBtn (eject-model-btn), loadConfirmModal, loadConfirmBtn (load-confirm), loadCancelBtn (load-cancel), loadConfirmText, unloadConfirmModal, unloadConfirmBtn (unload-confirm), unloadCancelBtn (unload-cancel), unloadConfirmText — all via getElementById.
3) REWRITE fetchModels(): fetch BOTH /api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/catalog (Promise.all). Options = lmstudio entries from /api/v1/models (source 'lmstudio', treat as loaded) plus ALL catalog entries. Option label: (loaded ? '\ud83d\udfe2 ' : '\u25cb ') + id; prefix '\u2713 ' additionally when id === modelSelect.value after restore. Set option value=id, data-loaded='true'/'false'. If the catalog fetch fails, fall back to lmstudio entries only (never show 'Failed to load models' if /api/v1/models succeeded). Preserve the existing previous-selection restore loop.
4) modelSelect 'change' listener: read selected option's data-loaded; if 'false', remember prior value, set loadConfirmText.textContent to 'Start ' + id + '? Uses significant RAM.' plus statusRam.textContent, un-hide load-confirm-modal. load-cancel: hide modal, restore prior selection. load-confirm: hide modal, disable modelSelect, start an interval (600ms) alternating the selected option's label glyph between '\u25cb ' and '\ud83d\udfe2 ', POST /api/v1/script-models/{id}/load; on ok clearInterval+refreshModels(); on fail clearInterval, restore prior selection, appendBubble error; finally enable modelSelect and pollStatus().
5) ejectModelBtn: reveal via modelSelect focus (ejectModelBtn.hidden=false) and hide on modelSelect blur AFTER a 200ms timeout (so a click on it still lands). Click: GET /api/v1/models/catalog, find first entry with loaded===true; if none, do nothing; else set unloadConfirmText.textContent='Unload '+id+'?', un-hide unload-confirm-modal. unload-cancel hides it. unload-confirm: hide modal, POST /api/v1/script-models/{id}/unload, then refreshModels() and pollStatus().
Change nothing else.

Modify src/api/models.py. KEEP every existing route and model class unchanged. ADD:
1) Import list_model_catalog from src.services.models (extend the existing import block).
2) Two pydantic models:
class CatalogEntry(BaseModel):
    id: str
    source: Literal['nemotron', 'deepseek-v4-flash']
    loaded: bool
class ModelCatalogResponse(BaseModel):
    models: list[CatalogEntry]
3) One new route directly after get_models:
@router.get('/models/catalog')
async def get_model_catalog() -> ModelCatalogResponse:
    return ModelCatalogResponse(models=[CatalogEntry(**m) for m in list_model_catalog()])

Self-verify before answering: the literal string 'models/catalog' appears in the file, list_model_catalog is imported, and every pre-existing route is still present unchanged.
